title: Milkdrop Web: mic-driven, beat-aware music visualizer for TVs and projectors — no audio routing
smallest_useful_product: Full-screen WebGL visualizer with 12 original shader presets driven by mic FFT + onset/beat detection, phrase-aware auto-rotation, and a local phone remote.
monetization: freemium — free presets; one-time venue pack
privacy: Microphone audio is processed locally and never recorded or uploaded.
